description: Get a single appointment group's core record — id, title, context_codes, workflow_state, and location — by id. None of its time slots, per-slot reservations, or participant counts come back unless you pass include with "appointments", "child_events", or "participant_count" respectively; omit include and you get only the core record. Find the id with list_appointment_groups. Use list_appointment_group_users or list_appointment_group_groups to see who has actually reserved a slot, and next_appointment to find the next slot still open to sign up for.

include.description: Extra data to include: appointments (time slots), child_events (per-slot reservations), participant_count

name: get_appointment_group
title: Get Appointment Group
